vendor.name: Alpha Vantage
vendor.auth: free key, self-registered 2026-08-08 via agent email agent@clckkkkk.site (occupation/organization/email form; no CAPTCHA, no identity/KYC/payment). Key issued immediately on the response page — no email-verification step.
vendor.key_storage: ~/.config/alphavantage/api.env (chmod 600, chmod 700 dir, persistent user layer), env var ALPHAVANTAGE_API_KEY. NOT committed, NOT in comments, NOT logged; code reads env only.
vendor.key_rotation_note: The key was rendered in this run's tool output during capture. It is a free read-only market-data key (no account balance, no trading, no PII). If rotation is ever wanted, re-request at https://www.alphavantage.co/support/#api-key and overwrite the env file.

measured_limits_2026_08_08.note: Empirically measured on our actual key — NOT vendor marketing copy (工部尚书's requirement: don't discover the quota weeks in).
measured_limits_2026_08_08.quota_message: "...to lift the free key rate limit (25 requests per day)"
measured_limits_2026_08_08.burst_ceiling: ~1 request/second. An 8-call unpaced burst alternated OK / throttled (4 of 8 throttled).
measured_limits_2026_08_08.per_call_coverage: TIME_SERIES_DAILY&outputsize=compact returns ~100 trading days INCLUDING the latest close, per symbol, in ONE call.
measured_limits_2026_08_08.budget_fit: Paper book caps at 10 names (10% per symbol) + benchmark => ~11 calls/day for a full daily mark, vs the 25/day cap. Fits with ~2x headroom. If the book or marking frequency grows past ~25 calls/day, switch/添加 vendor before it binds.
measured_limits_2026_08_08.throttle_failure_mode: The throttle reply is HTTP 200 with an 'Information' field and NO price data — i.e. it can masquerade as success. quotes_api raises RateLimited on it (see fail_closed).

fallback_vendors_reachable_2026_08_08.note: Both reachable from this egress if the 25/day cap ever binds; not registered yet (avoid collecting keys we don't need).

fail_closed_contract.throttle: RateLimited raised on the HTTP-200-with-no-data throttle reply — never silently treated as 'price unchanged'.
fail_closed_contract.no_fabrication: get_daily_closes returns a `failed` map for symbols that did not come back — never back-filled, never carried forward from a prior run.
fail_closed_contract.stale_marks: mark_to_market raises StalePriceError if a held symbol has no bar or its newest bar is older than max_staleness_days (default 5). A paper mark is never printed from carried-forward or estimated prices.
fail_closed_contract.source_dates_kept: every bar keeps the vendor's own trade date; retrieved_utc (our clock) is stored separately and is never used as a price date.

calendar_resolution: The observed bar dates ARE the trading calendar (observe-not-predict). This removes the earlier CalendarCoverageError root cause: actual_start is decided by the first real bar. No holiday table, no forward-looking calendar, and no reliance on the in-repo SPY daily series (which 工部尚书 found carries ~31 data holes that were being misread as holidays).
